risk_note: Gate tooling only (FU-EACH-UNEXPANDABLE-WHOLE-BLOCK, D10-2558 / D10-2559). A modify_existing entry may name a frozen .each / .for block by its title template text, exactly as written at the merge base, only when that base table cannot be expanded for certain; the block is then compared whole and counts as changed. A table that can be expanded still needs the Vitest-expanded names (the template is refused with a hint); a template that differs or matches several blocks is refused. A whole-block entry must be reason rule_change with a note (task.ts check, red-check before exempting, evidence-check --early and the final record all apply the same wholeBlockEntryProblem). Whole-block eligibility is decided once at the merge base and carried to the spec_commit-to-head check; the head side takes the template path only when the base side is whole. red-check attributes a reported name to the whole-block entry only when no other block of the head can produce it, and still judges its red reason (TypeError / missing module stay problems). The support check of a file-level support entry decides block authorisation by the located block index, not by re-matching the title. A trusted ledger that fails to parse is now a problem instead of an empty modify_existing (stricter only). All other entry shapes (static titles, expanded names, for...of rows, retitle_to, support) unchanged. No money, ledger or attribution code touched.
